clusters.headline: DPR RI Officially Passes Asset Recovery Law After 18-Year Delay
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian House of Representatives officially enacted the Asset Recovery Law following an 18-year legislative standstill.
The regulation allows for the seizure of assets from perpetrators of fraudulent investment schemes to compensate victims.

clusters.headline: Minister Raja Juli Antoni Rejects Mining in Ujung Kulon Park
aiSummaryBullets: Minister Raja Juli Antoni stated he will not issue forest area usage permits for mining activities within Ujung Kulon National Park.
The Minister clarified that potential relocation plans for Javan rhinos have been under study since 1986 and are not recent proposals.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Subianto And Xi Jinping Discuss Major Investment In China
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto held a bilateral meeting with President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen to strengthen strategic ties.
The discussions centered on significant economic cooperation, with potential investments reaching an estimated Rp1.600 trillion.

clusters.headline: Tito Karnavian And Various Indonesian Institutions Receive Awards
aiSummaryBullets: Interior Minister Tito Karnavian was honored for his efforts in improving public services and controlling regional inflation at the 2026 Detikcom Awards.
Several organizations and regional governments, including the Pekanbaru administration and Bank BJB, received awards for their environmental and economic initiatives.

clusters.headline: Bank Indonesia Raises Benchmark Interest Rate To Six Percent
aiSummaryBullets: Bank Indonesia increased the benchmark interest rate to 6 percent as a preemptive measure to support the weakening Rupiah.
The policy adjustment aims to contain national inflation and prepare for potential year-end interest rate hikes by the United States Federal Reserve.

clusters.headline: Security Guard Clings To Police Car Following Operation In PIK
aiSummaryBullets: A security guard in Jakarta's Pantai Indah Kapuk area climbed onto the hood of a moving vehicle after attempting to stop it.
Authorities identified the driver as a West Jakarta police officer conducting a drug-related operation.

clusters.headline: Antam Gold Prices Decline To Rp2.5 Million Per Gram In Indonesia
aiSummaryBullets: Antam gold prices fell by Rp11,000 to Rp2.5 million per gram on Friday.
Buyback prices for gold also experienced a notable decline of Rp78,000.

clusters.headline: Bareskrim Polri Postpones Case Review on Treason Allegations
aiSummaryBullets: Bareskrim Polri postponed a joint case review with the Attorney General's Office regarding treason allegations linked to presidential wiretapping.
Investigators are currently conducting house searches in Bogor and Tangerang to gather evidence on the suspected conspiracy and plot.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung Sets 2027 Provincial Minimum Wage
aiSummaryBullets: Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung officially announced the 2027 provincial minimum wage set at Rp6.1 million.
The new wage represents a 7.1 percent increase, equivalent to a raise of Rp407,000 compared to the previous year.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung Sets 2027 Provincial Minimum Wage
aiSummaryBullets: Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung announced the 2027 provincial minimum wage at Rp 6.136.941.
The new wage reflects an increase of Rp 407.065, or 7.1 percent, compared to the previous year.

clusters.headline: Government Sets Deadline For 2027 Minimum Wage Determination
aiSummaryBullets: The Minister of Manpower has instructed regional heads to finalize provincial minimum wage announcements by November 21, 2026.
New wage calculation guidelines incorporate data on the Decent Living Needs (KHL) alongside broader economic indicators.

clusters.headline: BMKG Issues Alerts For Rainfall And Strong Winds In Many Regions
aiSummaryBullets: The Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG) has forecasted light to heavy rainfall across numerous regions in Indonesia.
Specific warnings for heavy rain and strong winds were issued for 19 areas, following earlier reports of weather incidents in cities like Bogor.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Prepares Two Vice President Candidates
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto is scheduled to present two candidates for the vice presidential vacancy to the MPR on November 25.
Parties are discussing potential nominees, with Golkar publicly expressing support for Gerindra official Sufmi Dasco Ahmad.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Lawmakers Review Proposed Regulations For Regional Bonds
aiSummaryBullets: Commission XI of the Indonesian House of Representatives is reviewing a bill to authorize regional bond issuance.
The initiative aims to expand fiscal space for local governments beyond traditional budget reliance.

clusters.headline: KPK Questions BNPB Chief Secretary On Disaster Fund Procurement
aiSummaryBullets: The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) is examining the Secretary of the National Disaster Management Agency (BNPB) regarding disaster fund management.
Investigators are focusing on the process of direct vendor appointments for the procurement of goods and services within the agency.

clusters.headline: MPR Discusses Election Mechanism For New Vice President Nominees
aiSummaryBullets: The MPR ad hoc committee has commenced initial meetings to determine the formal mechanism for selecting the new Vice President.
Discussions focus on whether the selection will proceed through a vote rather than acclamation, alongside addressing specific inauguration procedures.

clusters.headline: Fire Damages Twelve Homes At A Military Housing Complex In Bogor
aiSummaryBullets: A fire destroyed twelve residential properties located at a military housing complex in the Lawanggintung area of Bogor.
Emergency response teams, including firefighters and Brimob water cannon units, contained the blaze after a three-and-a-half-hour effort.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Praises Police Chief Suyudi Appointment
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto publicly commended the selection of Suyudi as the new Chief of the Indonesian National Police.
The President noted that he did not personally know Suyudi prior to the appointment process.

clusters.headline: Polri Postpones Case Exposure of Alleged Treason by Listyo Sigit
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police delayed a scheduled case exposure with the Attorney General's Office concerning treason allegations.
The investigation involves former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo and others linked to the alleged illegal surveillance of President Prabowo Subianto.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Promotes Collaborative Innovation At APEC Summit
aiSummaryBullets: APEC leaders reached a formal consensus to strengthen economic collaboration and combat corruption across the region.
President Prabowo Subianto emphasized the necessity of open, fair, and innovative partnerships to achieve sustainable economic growth.
